## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added/updated and `npm test` is green
- [ ] Committed **exact paths only** (no `git add -A` — shared multi-agent working tree)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` entry added (newest on top) for user-visible changes
- [ ] Docs/specs updated if behavior or architecture changed
- [ ] Security invariants respected (envelope framing, official channels only, loopback/token guards, argv-only exec)
